'''Strong Will''' is a [[skill]].  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Any Phase''':  After making any [[Horror check]], spend 2 [[Clue token]]s to add 1 success to the result.  You may do this as often as you like.
